units.source_text: 我想用我所能找到的事实来安慰夫人，

en.t: I tried to comfort Madam with the facts I was able to find.

units.source_text: 夫人似乎也希望从我这里尽可能得到些安慰，

en.t: Madam, too, seemed to want to receive as much comfort as possible from me.

units.source_text: 所以我们长时间地谈论着这个问题。

en.t: So the two of us talked about the matter for a long time.

units.source_text: 可是，我完全没有把握事情的全貌，

en.t: But I had no grasp at all of the whole affair.

units.source_text: 而夫人的不安，其实也是从雾霭迷蒙般的困惑中产生的。

en.t: And Madam's uneasiness, in truth, had also arisen from a foglike haze of confusion.

units.source_text: 至于事情的真相，夫人自己也有很多不知道的，

en.t: As for the truth of the matter, there was much that Madam herself did not know.

units.source_text: 即使她知道的那部分也不能全都告诉我，

en.t: And even the part she did know, she could not tell me in full.

units.source_text: 因此劝慰夫人的我和被劝慰的夫人，都在困惑不解的波浪上漂来荡去，

en.t: Thus I, who was trying to console Madam, and Madam, who was being consoled, were both drifting back and forth on waves of bewilderment.

units.source_text: 在漂浮中夫人拼命地伸着手，想要抓住我这个靠不住的判断。

en.t: As she drifted, Madam reached out desperately, trying to cling to my unreliable judgment.

units.source_text: 十点左右，玄关外传来了先生的脚步声，

en.t: Around ten o'clock, Sensei's footsteps sounded outside the entrance.

units.source_text: 夫人就像突然忘了刚才的一切似的，

en.t: Madam seemed suddenly to have forgotten everything that had just happened.
Leaving me behind, she quickly stood up.

units.source_text: 去迎接先生，几乎和打开隔扇门进来的先生迎面碰上。

en.t: She went to greet Sensei and almost met him face to face as he opened the sliding lattice door and came in.

units.source_text: 被丢下的我，也跟着夫人起身迎接先生，

en.t: I, left behind, also got up and followed Madam to greet Sensei.

units.source_text: 只有女佣大概还在打盹，一直没出来迎接。

en.t: Only the maid, probably still dozing, never came out to greet him.
